minimax_h3_prompt_reference_doc.text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the little sister from <Picture 1>, a chibi girl with long wavy blue-gradient hair, a single bouncy ahoge, a white lace maid headdress, blue bow hair ornaments with small white wings, large round blue eyes, a navy lolita maid dress with a white apron printed with a blue whale, gold hem trim, white socks, navy shoes, and a small blue fin-shaped tail.
<Subject 2> is the older sister from <Picture 2>, a young woman with long dark hair fading into purple-magenta streaks, white feather hair ornaments, and an elegant white-and-purple sheer fantasy gown with gold accents and flowing translucent fabric.
<Subject 3> is the moonlit lakeside environment shown with <Subject 2> in <Picture 2>, featuring a huge full moon, a calm lake with drifting mist, and a mossy rock bank dotted with small white flowers.
<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S1), binding the little sister's spoken lines to its vocal character.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] The target video shows <Subject 1>, the little sister, running to visit <Subject 2>, the older sister, at <Subject 3>, the moonlit lakeside. The little sister calls out, clings to her sister's arm, and acts coquettish until the older sister warmly agrees to spend the day with her. <Audio 1> serves as the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S1) across all her lines.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the chibi build, blue-gradient hair, ahoge, lace headdress, whale-print apron dress, and fin tail are retained throughout.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the dark-to-purple hair, white feather ornaments, and white-and-purple sheer gown are retained.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the full moon, misty lake, and mossy rock bank remain the constant setting.
<Audio 1>: reference - the little sister's dialogue delivery follows <Audio 1>'s sweet young voice timbre without copying the original signal.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a soft fantasy anime style with luminous blue moonlight, a gentle glow, and a warm sisterly mood.
[Shot 1] A wide establishing shot shows <Subject 3>, the moonlit lakeside: an enormous full moon dominates the night sky above a calm lake, thin mist drifts over the water, and a mossy rock covered with small white flowers rises from a grassy bank in the foreground. <Subject 2>, the older sister with long dark hair fading into purple-magenta streaks, white feather hair ornaments, and a flowing white-and-purple sheer gown trimmed with gold, sits gracefully on the mossy rock, her translucent train spread over the stone as she gazes toward the water. From the left, <Subject 1>, the little sister with her blue-gradient hair, springy ahoge, lace headdress, whale-print apron dress, and little fin tail, runs into frame with quick, light steps, hair and apron fluttering. She stops in front of <Subject 2> and calls up at her in the bright, sweet young voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] 姐姐～我来找你玩啦！</d> The camera pushes in slowly as <Subject 2> turns her head, her expression softening into a smile.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the shot cuts to a medium two-shot beside the rock. <Subject 1> (S1) clings to <Subject 2>'s arm, hugging it with both small hands, swaying side to side and tilting her head so the ahoge bounces, looking up with wide, sparkling, pleading eyes in an unmistakably coquettish gesture. Keeping the same sweet voice timbre bound to <Audio 1>, she draws out her words playfully, <d>[Chinese] 陪人家玩嘛，好不好嘛？</d> She tugs the sleeve gently and puffs her cheeks in a tiny pout while moonlight rims both figures in silver.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 2> (S2), the older sister from Shot 1, smiling down warmly. She answers in a gentle, mature female voice, <d>[Chinese] 好呀，今天就一直陪着你。</d> She reaches out and pats <Subject 1>'s head between the lace headdress ribbons; the little sister beams, cheers softly, and nuzzles against her arm as the lake shimmers under the full moon behind them.

overall_soundscape:
Gentle night-lakeside ambience continues throughout: soft water lapping, a light breeze through the grass, faint insect chirps, and the subtle rustle of fabric as the sisters move.

non_diegetic_music:
A delicate music-box and harp score at a slow, lullaby-like tempo, with soft celesta accents that warm slightly when the older sister agrees to stay with her little sister.
